description: This file defines TypeScript types, functions, and classes for parsing and representing ARIA (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) snapshot data in YAML format, including role definitions, properties, and parsing utilities.

classes.name: KeyParser
classes.description: A class for parsing keys in ARIA YAML definitions, including handling of strings, regex, and attributes.

classes.name: ParserError
classes.description: Custom error class for parsing errors with position information.

methods.name: parseAriaSnapshotUnsafe
methods.description: Parses ARIA snapshot YAML text into an ARIA template node, throwing on errors.

methods.name: parseAriaSnapshot
methods.description: Parses ARIA snapshot YAML text into an ARIA template node, returning errors if any.

methods.name: valueOrRegex
methods.description: Converts a string into a string or regex pattern object if it appears to be a regex.
